hypotheses.O1_low_rank_input_forms: The leading four eigenmodes contain at least 50% of interaction-matrix energy for every top query-map component.
hypotheses.O2_top_modes_specific: For every component, top-eigenspace edits cause at least twice the median absolute component-score change of low-eigenspace edits.
hypotheses.O3_weight_prediction_matches_finite_effe: For every component, the restricted quadratic matrix predicts top-eigenspace finite score changes with correlation at least 0.80.
hypotheses.O4_top_modes_reach_logits: For every component, top-eigenspace edits cause at least twice the median final-logit KL of low-eigenspace edits.
hypotheses.O5_random_control: For at least three of four components, top-eigenspace edits cause larger median component-score effects than random shared-subspace edits.
